newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian T-bills rise ahead of competitive auction.
newsitem.headline: Russian T-bills rise ahead of competitive auction.

text.p: Prices of Russian medium and long-term government paper rose on Monday ahead of a weekly auction at which the government must raise relatively few funds to pay maturing bills and so can expect competitive bids.
*Average yield fell to 18.35 pct from 18.55 pct on Friday
*Turnover fell to 2.69 trln rbls from 4.05 trln rbls
*Traders transferred 2.58 trln rbls to trading accounts for the day's trade
*Central bank sold 403.24 bln rbls in bills, bonds
